text.0: A bald man in a white t-shirt with a mountain-sunset graphic stands in the foreground, facing away from the viewer, in a dimly lit, loft-style room. He stands left of center, near a wooden railing. Behind him, a diverse group of people, some wearing jerseys, sit on benches and chairs, looking towards a brick wall with red sound-dampening panels. A man in a light green shirt stands in front of this wall, seemingly presenting. Industrial-style overhead lights and exposed ductwork are visible, with reflections of small white and orange lights scattered across surfaces. On the right, a kitchen area with stainless steel appliances and a pot is visible. A red circular logo with a pig wearing a fedora and smoking a joint, with text "CLAUDE" and "SMOKE 'EM IF YOU GOT 'EM," overlays the bottom right corner.
text.2: A bald man in a plain white T-shirt stands before a painted backdrop of snowy mountains glowing under a pink-orange sunrise, while behind him looms a dim brick factory hall lit by bare hanging bulbs. Rows of workers sit on wooden chairs against red brick walls, listening as a teacher gestures and speaks animatedly. Nearby, a steaming pot bubbles on a stove beside a sizzling pan. In the corner, a plump pink pig in a black top hat smokes a cigar, its glowing red tip piercing the smoky, conspiratorial gloom.
text.4: An animated scene depicts a large, bald, tan-skinned figure with a black-dot smile and eyes, wearing a white shirt and dark blue pants, centered and facing forward. Behind them, against a red brick wall, hangs a rectangular painting of purple mountains with white snowy peaks against a gradient purple-to-orange sky. To the left, a cartoon pink pig wearing a black top hat stands on a wooden chair, smoking a red-tipped cigar, with smoke curling upwards. Seven other tan, bald figures in dark blue shirts sit on similar wooden chairs, arranged in two rows. To the right, a tall, tan figure in a dark green shirt and black pants stands with arms raised, gesturing, near a gray stove with a steaming pot and a frying pan containing yellow food. The dark ceiling features four glowing, circular lights.
text.6: This monochrome, green-on-black ASCII art depicts a room with a central, stylized figure resembling a person wearing a "WHITE SHIRT," facing forward with a simple smiling face. To the left, a "PIG" with a curly tail lies beside a block-like structure. Above the figure, a decorative element forms a jagged pattern resembling mountains. On the far right, a "STOVE" with a square top and small bracket-shaped legs is shown, with the legible text. The room is enclosed by brick-like walls, and the floor features arrangements of small, square objects, some with numbers and symbols, creating a grid-like texture. Overhead, four identical circular symbols with radiating lines hang, mirroring the floor arrangements.
text.8: A 3D, isometric, pixel-art style scene with a dark background and all objects rendered in shades of green. The scene is a rectangular room with brick-like walls on three sides, extending towards the viewer. The floor is composed of numerous small, square, green blocks, some of which display white numbers and symbols, resembling a calculator keypad. In the center stands a blocky, green figure with a smiling face, wearing a white shirt with "WHITE SHIR" written on it. To the left of the figure is a pink, blocky pig on the floor, next to a green block labeled "PIG". To the right is a green, rectangular block resembling a stove, labeled "STOVE". Above the back wall, four spiky green light fixtures are suspended, and below them are three green, triangular mountain-like shapes.
